crossRefs.note: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer…
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

translations.web: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.
translations.bsb: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God,
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: And the priest shall take the basket out of thy hand, and set it down before the altar of Jehovah thy God.
